# Fixture provenance

`grammar/` contains the 74 corpus source inputs and six model/header examples from
[tree-sitter-verilog-ams](https://github.com/nohgo/tree-sitter-verilog-ams/tree/0b2672e76ff2941fb62081b5d42b0ae84a0f6c46),
revision `0b2672e76ff2941fb62081b5d42b0ae84a0f6c46`. The applicable MIT license is
retained in `grammar/LICENSE`. Several digital cases originate in the grammar's
upstream `tree-sitter/tree-sitter-verilog` test corpus. Files are checked in so
formatter tests do not need a sibling checkout or a live simulator.
